correctness.rationale: The bijective Feller cycle insertion has singleton probability 1/n, giving G_n=(n-1+z)G_{n-1}/n. Classifying insertion positions before, at and after the marked record gives F_{n,i}=G_{n-1}/n+(n-i-1+z)F_{n-1,i}/n with boundary F_{i,i}=zG_{i-1}/i. The centered recurrence solves to H=(i-1)(z-1)G_{i-1}G_{n-i}/(i^2 binom(n,i)). Coefficient telescoping produces an exact nonnegative tail gap at every integer k, including i=1 equality and n=1. Derivative at z=1 gives covariance; total covariance is 1/n+O(n^-2) and Bernoulli harmonic variance is log n+O(1). Independent full-permutation rational enumeration n<=7 matches exact conditional PGF, tail sign and covariance; it is corroboration, not the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: Classical equality in distribution of record and cycle counts does not determine their dependence on a single original permutation. The exact marked conditional stochastic order, its boundary exception, every-threshold gap and sharp small total correlation form a natural uniform-in-n joint law, not a bare marginal restatement.

final_claim: For uniform pi in S_n and upper-record R_{n,i}, the conditional ordinary-cycle PGF is G_n(z)+(i-1)/(i*binom(n,i))*(z-1)*G_{i-1}(z)*G_{n-i}(z); its tail gap at k is the same prefactor times P(K_{i-1}+K_{n-i}=k-1). The same-pi covariance is (i-1)/(i^2*binom(n,i)), with total correlation asymptotic 1/(n log n).
limitations: Uniform permutations only, and conditioning on one specified upper left-to-right record; no Ewens generalization or positive association of the entire record vector is claimed.
The original derivation establishes the infinite family; independent exhaustive permutations stop at n=7.
Equivalent older cycle-record joint identities could remain undiscovered.
